Fix: I have an issue with the access time of the 70ns NOR flash if I calculate the the access time with the two relevant times (AdressSetupTime + DataSetupTime) * HCLK (4+7)*5.

Technical details:
I have an issue with the access time of the 70ns NOR flash if I calculate the the access time with the two relevant times (AdressSetupTime + DataSetupTime) * HCLK (4+7)*5.95ns = 65.4ns (@168MHz). The result is less than the needed 70ns.
